purpose: Independently recalculate the 6 maturity levels from primary repository evidence. Do not inherit existing labels.

definitions_from_guiding_document.IMPLEMENTED: All required code for the verification framework exists and compiles cleanly with ruff and mypy.
definitions_from_guiding_document.ARCHITECTURALLY_CONVERGED: Single canonical control plane, single planning authority, single execution authority, single capability authority, single evidence contract, single mutation authority, no dormant duplicates, no silent bypass, no capability blindness.
definitions_from_guiding_document.OPERATIONALLY_VALIDATED: Representative executions have completed through the canonical pipeline (plan → execute → evidence → reconcile → decision) for each required scenario, with results deterministic where expected, evidence complete, and history machine-readable.
definitions_from_guiding_document.SUSTAINED_IN_OPERATION: Repeated execution across multiple sessions / change cycles demonstrates the architecture holds without regression and operational history accumulates longitudinally.
definitions_from_guiding_document.CERTIFIABLE: A certification policy exists and is satisfied by the evidence trail; an external reviewer can rely on the evidence to issue a verdict.
definitions_from_guiding_document.SELF_VERIFYING: The framework can invoke its own canonical pipeline against its own architecture and detect (not merely assert) intentional architectural violations.

IMPLEMENTED.evidence: Required code present: control_plane_facade.py, executor_pipeline.py, obligation_reconciliation.py, capability_graph_resolver.py, mutation_runner, etc. Test suites compiled and collected (35+15+19+41+24+15+15+6+10=180+ tests). ruff and mypy run on changed files with no critical errors observed in Phase 3/4/6 narratives.
IMPLEMENTED.conditions: Acceptable modulo dirty working tree (87 uncommitted files) and the 10 evidence-kind violations being documentation/discipline issues, not implementation defects.

ARCHITECTURALLY_CONVERGED.evidence_for: Single ControlPlane (test passes), 85 legacy tokens delegated (no-duplicate-authority.json), 10/10 adapters registered, MutationOrchestrator bounded NON_CANONICAL, single evidence contract.
ARCHITECTURALLY_CONVERGED.evidence_against: 10 capability-catalog evidence-kind warnings persist — these are emitted by the canonical capability_catalog.py validator against the closed EVIDENCE_KINDS vocabulary. Each warning corresponds to a capability advertising an evidence kind outside the vocabulary. Until either (a) the vocabulary is expanded with governing-document amendment or (b) the capability is remapped to an existing kind, the architecture is not strictly converged on the evidence-contract dimension.
ARCHITECTURALLY_CONVERGED.conclusion: Substantially converged but NOT fully — the evidence contract is violated by 10 capabilities.

OPERATIONALLY_VALIDATED.evidence_for: 19-test operational suite mostly passes when re-run (15/16 under pytest-timeout=60).
OPERATIONALLY_VALIDATED.evidence_against: Zero of 54 recorded run JSONs have populated plan_identity, execution_identity, or evidence_identities. Every recorded run terminates at the planning stage or at a synthetic decision label. Scenario 15 (CI-equivalent) hangs. The '24 runs through the canonical pipeline' claim cannot be substantiated from the on-disk artifacts.
OPERATIONALLY_VALIDATED.conclusion: Operational validation as defined (representative executions through the canonical pipeline producing lineage) has NOT been achieved. Only planning-stage probes were recorded.

SUSTAINED_IN_OPERATION.evidence: Single-session execution. Cache hit rate 16% — operational effectiveness has regressed from the <50% Phase-0 baseline. No longitudinal evidence.
SUSTAINED_IN_OPERATION.conclusion: Cannot be claimed from a single session.

CERTIFIABLE.evidence: No certification policy defined; report acknowledges 'policy undefined' as remaining limitation.

SELF_VERIFYING.evidence_for: 35 self-verification tests pass; framework invokes its own ControlPlane.plan() (test_self_verification_cycle_runs).
SELF_VERIFYING.evidence_against: Negative-detection tests assert detection names exist in code rather than injecting real violations and proving detection fires. test_framework_detects_duplicate_authority_violation instantiates two ControlPlane objects and asserts same-class — proves class singularity, not detection. test_framework_detects_legacy_bypass checks migration_map contains the legacy token names — proves the map exists, not that bypass is caught at runtime. test_framework_detects_stale_evidence_reuse checks that the string 'stale_evidence_reuse' is in a bypass report — proves the report mentions it, not that bypass enforcement triggers on real stale evidence.
SELF_VERIFYING.conclusion: Structural self-tests only; genuine violation-detection (test the verifier verifies the verifier) has not been demonstrated.

report_claim_1.label: ARCHITECTURALLY_CONVERGED ✅
report_claim_1.recalculated: PARTIAL — evidence-kind violations (10) remain architectural defects

report_claim_2.recalculated: NO — 0/54 recorded runs reached execution; scenario 15 hangs

report_claim_3.recalculated: PARTIAL — structural self-tests only; negative detection is weak

report_claim_4.recalculated: NO — also requires the architecture to actually hold; cache hit rate 16% suggests it does not yet
